acceptance: `skills/codewiki/loops/` no longer exists or is referenced by active source/docs/tests.
Main `codewiki` skill routes to focused compiler skills without loading parallel loop files.
README/package smoke/restructure tests reflect the new skill structure.
non_goals: Do not remove focused public compiler skills, bootstrap assets, prompts, playbooks, or tool catalog.
verification: Run prompt asset, restructure, package smoke, and pack checks.
